reporting-org.narrative: European Bank for Reconstruction and Development

description.narrative: The Bank intends to extend a financing package of up to €25 million (US$ equivalent) to UzCarlsberg, consisting of both debt and equity components. The proceeds will be used to expand UzCarlsberg's production capacity and to support the Company's future growth initiatives. Key investments to cover brewing and bottling equipment, warehouse expansion, and strengthening of the route-to-market presence (the "Project"). The Project supports private sector development, inclusive human capital development and green transition across the sector.
